children: Argentina’s retail sales surged 23% year-on-year to ARS 707.8 billion in July 2026, accelerating from a 13.4% increase in June.

Sales of furniture, home décor, and household textiles rose the most, at 51.7%, followed by sportswear and accessories (46.3%), entertainment and leisure (45.1%), food courts, food outlets, and kiosks (29.3%), and bookstores and stationery (24.3%).
Sales increased 26% in Buenos Aires and 23.9% across the 24 districts of Greater Buenos Aires.
Meanwhile, sales in the Pampean Region rose 17.6%, while the Cuyo Region recorded a 17% increase.
Sales in the Northern and Patagonia regions increased 22.9% and 30.8%, respectively.

title: Argentina Retail Sales Growth Accelerates
